rationale: The current ES 8.8 Premier aggregate row requires Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR; the versioned task says Platform 10.2+ and ES 8.7+. The task also requires the enabled assistant, paired SOAR, permission to view an investigation containing an already triaged finding and inherited connector and asset access. The 8.7 task supplies historical scope. Both task versions retain the first-ten and roughly 200-per-tenant daily limits. The ES 8.8 task explicitly says Response cannot rerun and does not pick up findings added after the investigation was processed. For Cloud Connected customer-managed, the 8.8 aggregate/task point to Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0 and the overview names SAIA 2.4+. The official indexed setup page shows 2.0+ and SAIA 2.4+; its direct URL returned 404. The SAIA 2.3.6 install and known-issue sections still describe 2.4.0 Cloud Connected support as planned. GA is dated November 4; the exact October CA section remains unavailable.

deployments: Premier Cloud and Cloud Connected CMP
exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.

remainingConcerns: Independently reconcile the missing mapped SOC Controlled Availability section, the native result for this exact attempt and production delivery evidence. Review by November 12.
